intent: Replace permissive e2e checks with strict, isolated MCP protocol, lifecycle, schema, and BPMN behavior gates.
applied_fixes: Separated the helper response deadline from Jest's test deadline and added post-start timeout cleanup coverage.
Added isolated HOME and diagrams roots plus a no-default-directory-write sentinel.
Pinned complete input schemas, including descriptions, and restored the expected invalid-tool error contract.
Replaced per-request stdout listeners with a lifetime protocol parser and covered trailing malformed output.

suppressed_or_advisory.title: Opaque hashes hide the asserted schema contract
suppressed_or_advisory.reason: Retained as an intentional compact exact-contract representation; each mismatch identifies the tool and the canonical source schema remains directly reviewable. Expanding 24 schemas into a duplicate fixture would materially increase drift surface.

suppressed_or_advisory.title: Independent gates are coupled into one long scenario
suppressed_or_advisory.reason: The integrated create/connect/export chain is the bead's required semantic e2e gate and intentionally shares one initialized stateful MCP session; lifecycle failure modes remain separate tests.
